description: A tame saddled camel (speed 0.09, jump strength 0.42), sitting when mounted: the player looks aside (it keeps its heading) and presses jump (no charge while it sits); forward held gets it up (52 ticks, the rider rising with it) and walking; sprinting; a dash charged for 10 ticks, jump held again early and late in the cooldown; turning back, a sprinting dash charged for 6 ticks; sat down while walking (40 ticks, forward held meanwhile) and got up again with forward; a charged jump let go while it falls from 3 blocks up; in a 1-deep pool, made to sit there (it gets up at once), out over the edge; sneaking off.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
